subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should `sessions.files.list` ever expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths that are outside the fs-safe workspace root or rejected by fs-safe?
rationale: The PR's visible UX goal is valid, but the current implementation changes a file metadata boundary that repository policy treats as security-sensitive and compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
options.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve false Missing through filtering, a neutral external state, or directory-aware in-workspace logic that stays inside the workspace helper.

options.title: Accept External Metadata Deliberately
options.body: Allow external path metadata only after explicit security acceptance, protocol/UI documentation, and regression coverage for outside-root and symlink-rejected paths.

options.title: Split Layout From File Semantics
options.body: Keep the current focused layout fix and handle the linked issue's backend behavior in a separate maintainer-owned decision path.

recommendation.title: Keep Metadata Behind Fs-Safe
recommendation.body: Remove the raw stat fallback and solve false Missing through filtering, a neutral external state, or directory-aware in-workspace logic that stays inside the workspace helper.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the original workspace rail feature and have adjacent history on the affected session-files and UI surfaces.
